text:
maria: customer reports streaming response cuts mid-sentence after ~2m idle, client reconnects and final chunk is partial. They see a truncated JSON blob ending with "...tion of the".

devon: can you paste the client-side logs + full ingress chain? which edge/LB are they using?

maria: CF in front -> ALB -> nginx ingress on k8s. Customer pasted raw bytes from client trace:

maria: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
transfer-encoding: chunked

10
data: {"id":101,"text":"Processing your request..."}
0

f

data: {"id":102,"text":"Result: The conver"

*** connection reset by peer ***
```

lee: that looks like a chunk got truncated mid-json (ends with "conver"). could be proxy buffering + an idle probe closing the socket mid-chunk.

ingrid: ALB default idle timeout is 60s. if there's a chain (CF + ALB + nginx) and a long pause between tokens, an intermediate piece might think the connection is idle and reset. but mid-chunk truncation suggests TCP RST rather than graceful close.

samir: can we get a reproducible curl test? ask customer to run:

samir: ```bash
# bypass Cloudflare edge to hit ALB/origin directly (example)
curl -v -N --resolve api.example.com:443:10.11.12.13 \\  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\  https://api.example.com/stream?session=test123
```

devon: advise them to capture a tcpdump on origin while reproducing: `sudo tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/stream.pcap port 443` and include nginx access/error logs. also request ALB access logs and CF ray/id.

maria: customer tried the curl bypass and saw the stream intact when hitting origin directly, but when going through CF+ALB it truncated after ~90s. they shared ALB logs with a final status code 504 around the time of truncation.

lee: 504 from ALB suggests an idle timeout or target group health/close. check ALB idle timeout and target group deregistration time. also verify NLB vs ALB in front of nginx; NLB can send RSTs on idle.

ingrid: nginx side: confirm these settings in the ingress/nginx config: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection "";` and ensure `chunked_transfer_encoding on;` so nginx will stream properly. also set `proxy_read_timeout` to a higher value (e.g., 300s).

samir: on ALB, bump `idle_timeout.timeout_seconds` to 300 for the target group and set `deregistration_delay` appropriately. on Cloudflare, disable Response Buffering / enable "Origin Cache Control" passthrough and test in Development Mode to bypass CF optimizations.

devon: recommend adding a small heartbeat token from origin every 15s to keep intermediaries from treating connection as idle: send `:\n` or `comment\n\n` (SSE comment) or a `data: "\u200b"\n\n` token if client expects data.

maria: customer asked if nginx's `keepalive_timeout` matters — yes, ensure upstream keepalive between nginx and app server is > ALB idle. set `keepalive_timeout 75;` and `proxy_send_timeout`/`proxy_connect_timeout` to > ALB idle.

lee: also check if Cloudflare is using HTTP/2 to the client and HTTP/1.1 to origin; mixing protocols can cause buffering behavior. set `proxy_buffering off` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no` header from app as a safety.

maria: next steps I asked customer to: 1) run the curl bypass test and attach pcap + nginx logs, 2) temporarily raise ALB idle timeout to 300 and disable CF buffering (Dev Mode) and retry, 3) enable periodic SSE heartbeat on origin, 4) if using nginx ingress, apply `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_http_version 1.1`.

samir: if they reproduce consistently, we'll escalate to eng-runtime with pcap and logs. include ALB and CF trace ids.

maria: customer shared a small repro app and allowed a test run. I'm scheduling a quick capture window tomorrow at 09:00 PST. will post results. :eyes:

incident-bot: Escalation opened: SEV3 -> eng-runtime, ticket RED-12345. assignee: lee.

devon: if this persists after the above changes, next steps: run a minimal origin that emits deterministic SSE every 5s (to rule out app-level buffering), and try passing through an AWS NLB directly to see if the problem is ALB-specific.

maria: thanks all — will update thread after the capture.
